text:
Elena: Quick question — I'm sketching an 'anchor' routing mode. idea: if a tenant (or API key) historically hits v1 and the client omits a version header, we keep routing them to v1 for a TTL instead of auto-upgrading to v2. reduces surprise breakage. thoughts? :thinking_face:

Omar: Per-tenant makes sense but can hide migration issues. why not per-token? per-token is safer but more noisy to operate.

Jun: If we do anchor we need clear telemetry: route_mismatch_rate, probe_success_rate, and a per-tenant probe sample hitting v2. also think about decay (if client actively calls v2 we should expire anchor).

Priya: Console UX: admins will want an "Anchor" toggle and a preview that shows projected % traffic that would move to v2, estimated cost delta, and latency delta before flipping. important for adoption.

Maya: Implementation note: TTL-based anchor + configurable probe_rate. sample config might look like:

```
route_policy:
  anchor_mode: tenant  # tenant | token | none
  anchor_ttl_days: 14
  probe_rate: 0.005  # 0.5% of requests get probed to v2
  probe_billing_exempt: true
```

Elena: Good. I want tenant opt-in by default (new tenants anchored) but org-admins can force-upgrade or disable anchor. also need clear console messaging so customers know why some calls still go to v1.

Omar: Billing question: if probes hit v2, do they count against the customer's v2 quota/billing? I'd prefer probes be meterless or at least flagged so finance can exclude them from normal billing to avoid spikes.

Priya: Agreed. add a separate metric/series for probe traffic and a flag probe_billing_exempt. console should expose "probe_cost" and "probe_latency" so admins can decide to opt-out if probes are too expensive.

Maya: Edge cases: pinned API keys, signed webhooks, and server-to-server integrations might rely on v1 specifics. Anchor must never change response shape for pinned keys unless admin overrides. also need canary rollout (0.1% tenants) before broad enable.

Elena: Proposed default params for RFC: anchor_ttl 14d, probe_rate 0.5%, admin console toggle per-tenant, probe_billing_exempt=true, auto-expire if explicit v2 header seen. create RFC + console mock.

Omar: We should also surface a "compat risk" heatmap: tenants with high route_mismatch_rate and lots of implicit-version traffic. helps prioritize outreach.

Jun: I'll prototype telemetry dashboard. metrics we'll emit: routing.anchor.<tenant>.v1_rate, routing.anchor.<tenant>.probe_rate, compat.probe.billed (true/false), routing.anchor.expirations. will also add trace tags for probe vs anchor routes.

Priya: For the console preview we need a small cost projection: use historical token rates + known v1/v2 unit prices to simulate 7/30 day delta. i'll draft UX copy for risk + cost. cc @finance.

Maya: :thumbsup: schedule a short sync to align infra/console/ops. next Tue 11:00 works for me.

Elena: @deploy-bot can you create the RFC ticket and assign to Jun/Priya to start the mockups?

deploy-bot: Created ticket infra#3421 — "anchor-mode routing RFC" — created by Elena. Assigned to Jun, Priya. ETA: draft by EOW.

Jun: I'll start the telemetry prototype tomorrow and wire a simple heatmap in Grafana.

Omar: Also add a small experiment: toggle removal window with a rollback button in console so support can undo a forced upgrade quickly.

Priya: Noted. I'll include a rollback affordance in the mock.

Maya: ok cool — meeting invite incoming.

Elena: Thanks all. short RFC + mocks then a pilot. :rocket:
